Global Master of Business Administration (GMBA)
Tuition fees for the GMBA program are calculated as follows:
Tuition Fees = Basic Tuition + (Cost per Credit Hour x Credit Hours)
Note: The above fees are applicable to all overseas students.

Executive Master of Business Administration (EMBA)
For EMBA program, there are 3 semesters per academic year. EMBA students pay full tuition for the first 6 semesters. From the seventh semester on, tuition fees are calculated as follows:
Tuition Fees = Basic Tuition + (Cost per Credit Hour x Credit Hours)
Tuition fees are capped and will not exceed the full tuition in the current semester.
